reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share an update on the music system in Provincia! No more jarring transitions when day turns to night or during combat. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless audio experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
